title: Privacy notice
updated: Last updated: 26 November 2026. Silver Vibe™ is a personal open-source project. This notice describes how we process personal data for the product at silvervibe.io. It is a working draft for transparency; a lawyer should review it before you rely on it for customers in the EEA/UK. Contact

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The project operator of Silver Vibe acts as controller for personal data processed through the hosted apps (portal, VibeStandup, VibePoll, VibeRetro, VibeFeedback, VibeMeeting) and the Nest API. Contact for privacy requests:

collect.title: What we collect
collect.intro: Depending on which tools you use, we may process:
collect.account: Account identifiers from Firebase Authentication: email address, display name, and Firebase user id. We store a matching user row in Neon Postgres so the API can authorize requests.
collect.workspace: Workspace and team membership, roles, plan keys, and which tools are enabled for a workspace.
collect.standup: Standup entries (for example yesterday / today / needs help text), timezone, work-hours preferences, away periods, and generated team digests.
collect.products: Product content you create in other tools: poll questions and votes, retro notes, feedback prompts and answers, meeting agenda items, decisions, and actions.
collect.invites: In-app invites to workspace members (and any email addresses used only to send team invites when that feature is used).
collect.oauth: OAuth connection metadata and access tokens for add-ons you connect (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Trello) so digests and mentions can run. Tokens are stored for the workspace and are not shown in the UI after connect.
collect.technical: Technical logs needed to operate and secure the service (for example request metadata on Cloud Run / Cloudflare).

use.title: How we use it
use.body: We use this data to provide sign-in, workspaces, the product tools you enable, digests and mentions to connected chat or trackers, and to secure and improve the service. We do not sell personal data. We do not use it for unrelated advertising. For EEA/UK users, the usual bases we rely on (subject to legal review) are performing the service you request and, where needed, legitimate interests in operating a secure product. Optional AI polish is described below.

processors.title: Processors and recipients
processors.intro: We use service providers that process data on our behalf or as independent providers of their own services:
processors.cloudflare: Cloudflare — DNS and Pages hosting for frontends.
processors.cloudrun: Google Cloud Run — Nest API and LangGraph AI service.
processors.addons: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Atlassian Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and/or Trello — only when a workspace admin connects that add-on; digests or mentions may then include standup or related content you already stored.
processors.gemini: Google Gemini (via Google AI) — only when the operator enables AI standup digests and configures a Gemini API key; then standup entry text may be sent to Google to polish the digest. Classic (non-LLM) digests do not call Gemini.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Several processors are based in the United States or process data globally (including Google and Cloudflare). Where GDPR applies, transfers rely on the safeguards those providers publish (for example Standard Contractual Clauses). Ask us if you need the current list of sub-processors for your workspace.

ai.title: Optional AI polish (Gemini)
ai.body: AI digest polish is off unless the operator sets AI_STANDUP_SUMMARY on the API and a Gemini key on the AI service. When both are on, regenerating or posting a team digest may send that day’s standup answers to Google for rewriting. This is operator-controlled infrastructure configuration, not a per-user marketing consent box. Workspace admins should tell members before enabling it. You can ask us to confirm whether AI polish is currently enabled for the hosted environment.

retention.title: Retention and your rights
retention.body: Account and product data are kept while your account and workspaces exist, and for a short period afterward in backups. You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or a copy of your data, and you may object where applicable, by emailing

rightsExtra.body: If you are in the EEA/UK you may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. Deleting your Firebase account does not automatically wipe every workspace row; contact us so we can help remove Neon data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this notice as the product evolves. When we do, we change the date at the top of this page. Material changes will be called out on this page; we do not treat continued use alone as acceptance of a new policy. Please re-read this notice when the date changes.
